stem: Based on the excerpt and your knowledge of U.S. history, which long-term change in American society is reflected by the ratification of the Eighteenth Amendment?

options.label: A
options.text: It reflected the government’s desire to support foreign alcohol manufacturers.

options.label: B
options.text: It reflected the country’s hope of increasing participation in religious organizations.

options.label: C
options.text: It reflected the government’s shift to a more active role in the lives of citizens.

options.label: D
options.text: It reflected the country’s eagerness to move past the hardships caused by World War I.

visual_elements:
After one year from the ratification of this article the manufacture, sale, or transportation of intoxicating liquors within . . . the United States . . . for beverage purposes is hereby prohibited.  
—Eighteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution
